rv.q: “The Flying Lovers of Vitebsk” is an ethereal and beautiful production.
"The Flying Lovers of Vitebsk" is ultimately a testament to the possibilities of combining multiple art forms into one cohesive theatrical experience.

Ultimately, Theater J’s production succeeds most consistently as a work of art, with every detail — from the aerials, choreography, and live music to the visuals and poetic language — carefully chosen and skillfully performed, and as a poignant tribute to Bella and Marc's love and the war-ruined Jewish Vitebsk.
However, despite the satisfaction of a poignant finish, the journey along the way can be shaky.
There is never a moment in this one hour and twenty minutes, without intermission, that you aren’t completely enthralled with all of them.

cn.t: Critics praise this visually enchanting production for its unique blend of theater, music, and aerial performance, calling it a beautiful and memorable work of art that brings the Chagalls' whimsical love story to vivid life.
